title: $1,000 in TSMC in 2010 is now worth this
caption:
In 2010, TSMC was making other companies' chips.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:TSM:2010-01-04} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with TSMC in 2010? 👇
sources: TSMC price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 2010, TSMC was making other companies' chips.
Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Watch what it turns into. Today, it would be worth about {growth:TSM:2010-01-04}.
